description: Test suite for the TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer component, verifying watchdog timeout values for different language profiles and input lengths.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for validating the behavior of TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutDefaultsToLatinProfile
methods.description: Tests that the default watchdog timeout is 24 seconds when no language is specified.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesKoreanProfile
methods.description: Tests that the watchdog timeout is 75 seconds for Korean language input.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesChineseProfile
methods.description: Tests that the watchdog timeout is 84 seconds for Chinese language input.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutUsesJapaneseProfile
methods.description: Tests that the watchdog timeout is 60 seconds for Japanese language input.

methods.name: testWatchdogTimeoutClampsVeryLongUtterances
methods.description: Tests that very long input texts are capped at a maximum timeout of 900 seconds.
